whenToUse: A small-batch shop selling its own products with variants, cart drawer and checkout.
Craft brands that pair a catalogue with a maker story and newsletter.
avoidWhen: Timed drops and limited runs — use site-store-02.
a11y: Glaze swatches are a keyboard-operable radiogroup; cart updates announce through role="status".
Trap focus in the cart drawer and return it to the cart button on close.
